<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Alison has confirmed that she has created the booking for Wednesday, November 18, from 15:00 to 15:30.
My final task is to send the confirmation email to all four partners.

I will use the `send_confirmation_email` function to do this.
The email should contain the date and time of the meeting.
The day is Wednesday, which I will abbreviate to 'Wed'.
The start time is 15:00.
The body of the email should be a professional confirmation of the meeting.
I will write a short message for the body of the email.
After sending the email, the task will be complete, so I will end my session.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
